think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/auto/unlimited). 3) Determine whether such values are permitted for this knob and whether they break the natural numeric ordering by triggering a qualitatively different mode. 4) Classify as special only if at least one sentinel value exists with distinct behavior; otherwise classify as non-special.
